doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Taking time off to shop and practice
summary: When tired of playing she skipped film and stage work, went shopping and practiced.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: You talked about that yesterday. Were there any other attempts for you to get movie work or stage work?
Didn’t you pursue more films or stage work?
Sometimes I would get tired of playing and didn’t want to work much.
And what would you do during those times? How would you continue to pay the bills?
I would go shopping and practice. I like to go shopping.
Tell me about that. That seems to be one of your hobbies.
They say, “Shop ‘til you drop.” But I understand when you go shopping you won’t have much money. But I love to shop. Still do. I don’t do it too much now.
